analysis: This release represents a major update to the MCP Python SDK, bringing support for the latest protocol revision and significant API simplification, though some planned extensions and client features are deferred.
facts: This is v2.0.0, the stable v2 release of the MCP Python SDK.
It supports the 2026-07-28 revision of the Model Context Protocol and serves every earlier revision from the same server.
`pip install mcp` now installs 2.x.
v1.x is in maintenance mode and will only receive security fixes from now on.
The tasks extension (SEP-2663) is not part of this release.
On the client, the DPoP proof binding (SEP-1932) and the workload-identity `jwt-bearer` grant are not implemented.

canonical_title: Scientific computing in the age of agentic AI
facts: OpenAI published a field report on July 28, 2026.
The report shows how scientists use AI coding agents to modernize scientific computing, accelerating software development and discovery in genomics and beyond.
OpenAI Python library version 2.50.0 was released on 2026-07-28.
New feature: transcription model updates.
Bug fix: restored transcription keyword overload in audio.
Full changelog: https://github.com/openai/openai-python/compare/v2.49.0...v2.50.0
